title: Emergency and Catastrophic-Risk Cluster Record Profile
controls: Emergency, Catastrophic-Risk, and Continuity Interface Specification v0.1

relationship_types.implements: One domain record satisfies the canonical purpose and all applicable canonical minimum fields.
relationship_types.extends: The domain record includes the complete canonical record plus additional domain-specific fields or controls.
relationship_types.splits: Two or more domain records jointly satisfy one canonical record; every component and the assembly rule are declared.
relationship_types.contains: One domain package contains two or more canonical records as separately identifiable subrecords with distinct authorities, legal effects, timestamps, and lifecycle states.
relationship_types.imports: The canonical record is used directly without domain renaming.
relationship_types.not_applicable: A competent function records that the canonical trigger cannot arise in the specific event or action package, with reasons and review conditions.

access_classes.AC-1 Public: Record is public by default, subject to narrowly defined redactions.
access_classes.AC-2 Public summary / protected annex: Core authority and effect are public; sensitive evidence, operations, or personal data are protected.
access_classes.AC-3 Restricted operational: Access is role-bound, logged, time-limited, and reviewable; a public mission/process summary remains required where safe.
access_classes.AC-4 Protected sovereignty or source: Access and disclosure follow the authority of the affected Indigenous nation, protected source, privilege holder, or lawful custodian.
access_classes.AC-5 Sealed adjudicative or security mat: Access requires separately valid judicial, professional, or security authority and does not eliminate correction, review, retention, or disposition duties.

records.title: Hazard Alert Record
records.applicability_trigger: A person, sensor, institution, or protected source reports a condition that may require assessment.
records.cardinality: 0..n per event; alerts remain distinct unless explicitly merged.
minimum_fields: observed condition, location, and affected systems
statement that the alert has no coercive effect
common_links: ECRC-19 when sensitive data are processed
records.default_access: Public summary with protected-source annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by assessment, withdrawal, merger with traceable provenance, or archival disposition.
records.prohibited_inference: An alert does not declare an emergency, establish causation, assign blame, or activate power.

records.title: Observation Contract
records.applicability_trigger: An observation programme, model, dashboard, monitoring network, laboratory, or assessment process is commissioned or relied upon.
records.cardinality: At least one per materially distinct observation function or provider.
minimum_fields: variables, methods, models, and sampling limits
known blind spots and failure modes
conflicts of interest and independence safeguards
access, retention, correction, and deletion rules
common_links: ECRC-20 when protected knowledge is involved
records.default_access: Public summary with technical or protected annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by expiry, replacement, suspension, or documented termination and data disposition.
records.prohibited_inference: An observation contract does not make its outputs legally binding or self-executing.

records.title: Catastrophic-Risk State Estimate
records.applicability_trigger: A decision-relevant hazard or system condition requires a structured estimate.
records.cardinality: 1..n per decision question; competing estimates may coexist.
minimum_fields: evidence for and against each hypothesis
affected-area, Indigenous, worker, and operator accounts
records.default_access: Layered transparency; public summary unless doing so creates material risk
records.closure_condition: Superseded by a later estimate, closed by resolved question, or archived with unresolved status in ECRC-33.
records.prohibited_inference: A state estimate does not declare an emergency, prove legal causation, or authorize intervention.

records.title: Observation Independence Map
records.applicability_trigger: A state estimate or monitoring system depends on multiple observers, models, laboratories, or data providers.
records.cardinality: At least one per major estimate or decision package.
minimum_fields: funding, ownership, institutional affiliation, and shared dependencies
records.default_access: Public summary with protected security annex where necessary
records.closure_condition: Updated whenever material observers, dependencies, or conflicts change.
records.prohibited_inference: A count of observers does not establish independence, validity, or consensus.

records.title: Standing and Jurisdiction Map
records.applicability_trigger: A condition may affect multiple territories, peoples, sectors, professional regulators, or legal decision classes.
records.cardinality: At least one before any consequential cross-domain or cross-border action.
minimum_fields: courts, review bodies, and mutual-aid instruments
authority that will decide each disputed question
records.default_access: Public summary with protected annex for security-sensitive details
records.closure_condition: Closed only when all active functions have an identified authority or an explicit authority gap is recorded.
records.prohibited_inference: Mapping standing or jurisdiction does not create it, resolve contested sovereignty, or authorize action.

records.title: Emergency Authority Provenance Record
records.applicability_trigger: Any consequential emergency act, declaration, deployment, restriction, compulsory measure, seizure, or extraordinary expenditure is proposed.
records.cardinality: One per authority/action bundle; separate records for materially different powers or legal bases.
minimum_fields: territorial, personal, subject-matter, and temporal jurisdiction
review, appeal, expiry, renewal, termination, and restoration
records.default_access: Public summary plus protected legal/operational annex
records.closure_condition: Expires with the power, is superseded by a new valid record, or is invalidated and routed to restoration.
records.prohibited_inference: The record documents authority; it does not manufacture authority where the underlying instrument is absent or invalid.

records.title: Emergency Declaration Record
records.applicability_trigger: Applicable law requires a formal declaration before specified emergency powers or resources may be used.
records.cardinality: One per declaring authority and territorial/legal scope; multiple declarations may coexist.
minimum_fields: declared condition, territory, population, and functions
powers not activated by the declaration
conditions for refusal, amendment, renewal, or termination
records.default_access: Public except narrowly protected operational details
records.closure_condition: Closed by expiry, withdrawal, judicial invalidation, replacement, or ECRC-27.
records.prohibited_inference: A declaration does not activate every emergency power, transfer command, establish liability, or override unrelated institutions.

records.title: Power Activation and Prohibition Schedule
records.applicability_trigger: A valid authority proposes to activate one or more specific emergency powers.
records.cardinality: One schedule per authority and activation period; each power is separately enumerated.
minimum_fields: each activated power and legal basis
territorial, personal, functional, and temporal scope
start, review, expiry, and renewal dates
data, finance, work, and command dependencies
records.default_access: Public summary with protected operational annex
records.closure_condition: Each power closes separately by expiry, termination, invalidation, or replacement.
records.prohibited_inference: Activation of one power does not imply activation of another or create residual authority.

records.title: Operational Command and Deployment Record
records.applicability_trigger: Personnel, assets, facilities, or operational modules are deployed or coordinated.
records.cardinality: One per mission, command chain, or materially distinct module.
minimum_fields: commander or coordinating lead and professional autonomy boundaries
worker safety, liability, claims, and insurance
handoff, withdrawal, termination, and asset-return conditions
records.default_access: Restricted operational record with public mission summary
records.closure_condition: Closed by mission termination, handoff acceptance, demobilisation, and verified asset/credential return.
records.prohibited_inference: Operational command does not confer legal jurisdiction beyond the specifically authorized mission.

records.title: Host and Territorial Authorization Record
records.applicability_trigger: Assistance, deployment, access, facility use, data collection, or operations occur in another territory or under another host authority.
records.cardinality: At least one per host jurisdiction or affected territory.
minimum_fields: access, search, data, sample, and equipment permissions
costs, liability, claims, and immunities if lawfully granted
common_links: ECRC-11 where Indigenous territory is affected
records.default_access: Public summary with protected operational annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by withdrawal, expiry, completion, revocation, or verified handback.
records.prohibited_inference: Host authorization does not waive rights, create blanket immunity, or authorize unrelated intelligence collection.

records.title: Indigenous Emergency Interface Record
records.applicability_trigger: An emergency action, observation, assistance mission, or data/knowledge process may affect an Indigenous people, nation, territory, resource, relation, or protected knowledge.
records.cardinality: One per affected Indigenous nation or validly designated interface; no universal proxy.
minimum_fields: affected people or nation and chosen representatives
decision class and inherent or recognized authority
knowledge, data, sample, genetic, cultural, and spiritual protections
non-transfer, non-publication, non-training, return, deletion, or destruction conditions
immediate-rescue exception if any and its narrow limits
benefit, compensation, restoration, and grievance routes
records.default_access: Protected sovereignty record; public information only by affected authority
records.closure_condition: Closed by affected authority, completion of obligations, or documented non-engagement; survival of non-transfer terms is explicit.
records.prohibited_inference: The record does not create a universal Indigenous representative or convert consultation into consent.

records.title: Affected-Community Liaison Record
records.applicability_trigger: Communities face material effects, displacement, restrictions, uncertainty, or operational presence.
records.cardinality: One per materially distinct affected community or liaison structure.
minimum_fields: community definition and liaison selection method
needs, concerns, local observations, and dissent
support, grievance, correction, and feedback channels
records.default_access: Public summary with protected participant annex
records.closure_condition: Closed after obligations, grievances, and unresolved issues are transferred or resolved.
records.prohibited_inference: A liaison record does not establish consent, erase dissent, or authorize action.

records.title: Rights and Non-Derogation Record
records.applicability_trigger: A proposed or active measure may affect rights, liberties, equality, accessibility, bodily integrity, livelihood, family life, due process, or protected continuity.
records.cardinality: At least one per activation package; supplemental records for distinct measures.
minimum_fields: disability, age, gender, racial, migration, institutionalization, and socioeconomic effects
procedural safeguards, notice, review, and appeal
support required to make voluntary compliance possible
monitoring for discriminatory or cumulative effects
records.default_access: Public summary with protected personal annex
records.closure_condition: Updated throughout the measure and closed only after restoration and outstanding remedies are recorded.
records.prohibited_inference: A rights review does not cure an invalid legal basis or make a disproportionate measure lawful.

records.title: Health Measure and Bodily Integrity Record
records.applicability_trigger: A measure affects vaccination, prophylaxis, testing, treatment, triage, medical examination, sample collection, or other bodily integrity.
records.cardinality: One per materially distinct health measure and affected legal regime.
minimum_fields: measure, target population, and clinical purpose
records.default_access: Public clinical/legal summary with confidential personal data
records.closure_condition: Closed after expiry, follow-up, data/sample disposition, and unresolved claims transfer.
records.prohibited_inference: The record does not authorize forced treatment or establish clinical appropriateness for an individual.

records.title: Isolation, Evacuation, and Shelter Record
records.applicability_trigger: People may be isolated, quarantined, evacuated, excluded, relocated, or housed in emergency shelter.
records.cardinality: One per measure, area, authority, and affected population.
minimum_fields: food, water, shelter, income, caregiving, communication, health, disability, and family supports
safety, privacy, policing, and non-discrimination safeguards
return, release, compensation, and property protection
records.default_access: Public rules with protected individual records
records.closure_condition: Closed by release/return, property and service restoration, and disposition of personal data.
records.prohibited_inference: The record does not permit collective punishment, indefinite confinement, or unsupported evacuation.

records.title: Emergency Work Mobilisation Record
records.applicability_trigger: Workers, volunteers, community responders, contractors, public servants, or security personnel are mobilized.
records.cardinality: One per workforce, employer/organizer, and mission.
minimum_fields: roles, employer or responsible entity, and command
wages, benefits, insurance, pensions, and hazard pay
training, credentials, supervision, equipment, and staffing
hours, rotation, rest, family, mental-health, and disability support
safe refusal, withdrawal, whistleblowing, and anti-retaliation
injury, exposure, claims, and long-term follow-up
records.default_access: Public labour standards with protected personnel annex
records.closure_condition: Closed after demobilisation, final pay, claims transfer, credential return, and follow-up arrangements.
records.prohibited_inference: Recognition, solidarity, Hearts, civic duty, or emergency rhetoric does not replace wages and protections.

records.title: Essential Services and AUBI Continuity Record
records.applicability_trigger: An emergency may interrupt essential care, utilities, food, shelter, communications, justice, income support, or AUBI Layer 1.
records.cardinality: At least one per affected essential-service network or territory.
minimum_fields: supply, staffing, power, communications, and cyber dependencies
records.default_access: Public continuity summary with protected infrastructure annex
records.closure_condition: Closed after ordinary capacity is restored or a lawful long-term transition is approved.
records.prohibited_inference: The record does not authorize discrimination, political conditionality, or diversion of protected personal balances.

records.title: Emergency Finance and Compensation Record
records.applicability_trigger: Emergency funds, forecast finance, procurement, guarantees, reserves, compensation, or extraordinary expenditures are used.
records.cardinality: One per funding instrument, authority, and accounting unit.
minimum_fields: funding source, amount, currency, and custody
eligible uses, recipients, and disbursement rules
procurement, conflicts, fees, and beneficial ownership
forecast or parametric trigger and basis-risk safeguards
audit, correction, appeal, and fraud controls
worker, community, and claimant compensation reserves
expiry, clawback limits, residual funds, and closeout
records.default_access: Public fiscal summary with protected anti-fraud annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by audited reconciliation, compensation-reserve transfer, and lawful disposition of residual funds.
records.prohibited_inference: A framework, metric, or emergency label does not create tax, debt, seizure, or appropriation authority.

records.title: Data, Privacy, Security, and Secrecy Record
records.applicability_trigger: Emergency observation or action processes personal, health, genetic, operational, infrastructure, model, communications, or security-sensitive data.
records.cardinality: At least one per data system, controller/custodian, and purpose; linked records for shared processing.
minimum_fields: data categories, subjects, sources, and purposes
controller, custodian, processor, and access roles
collection limits, minimization, accuracy, correction, and contestation
security, logging, breach response, and model safeguards
sharing, cross-border transfer, and protected non-transfer
retention, deletion, archival, and emergency-expiry rules
public summary, secrecy rationale, and review
AI or automated-system role and human responsibility
records.default_access: Layered access; never presumed public
records.closure_condition: Remains active until ECRC-29 verifies disposition or a valid ordinary-law basis replaces the emergency basis.
records.prohibited_inference: Data possession, dashboard visibility, or model output does not create decision authority or permit secondary use.

records.title: Protected Knowledge and Non-Transfer Record
records.applicability_trigger: Knowledge, samples, genetic material, cultural information, sacred relations, source identities, security information, or dual-use material requires protected handling.
records.cardinality: One per protected knowledge domain, source authority, or non-transfer obligation.
minimum_fields: protected subject and authority to set conditions
permitted purpose, users, locations, and duration
non-transfer, non-publication, non-training, non-commercialization, and derivative-use conditions
security, custody, access logging, and breach response
return, repatriation, deletion, destruction, or continuing custody
records.default_access: Protected; public existence/summary only where authorized
records.closure_condition: Closed only when the originating authority confirms disposition or continuing obligations are transferred.
records.prohibited_inference: The record does not convert protected knowledge into a global commons or infer consent from emergency need.

records.title: Public Information and Correction Record
records.applicability_trigger: Authorities or operational bodies issue warnings, advice, uncertainty statements, corrections, orders, or service information.
records.cardinality: One per communication stream, issuing function, and material correction cycle.
minimum_fields: content type: observation, advice, request, or legal order
distinction between public-health/disaster advice and compulsory measures
correction, retraction, archive, and appeal process
misinformation-risk controls without propaganda or covert persuasion
common_links: ECRC-07 or ECRC-08 for legal orders
records.default_access: Public by purpose, with protected drafting/source annex
records.closure_condition: Closed when superseded, corrected, archived, and linked to final after-action account.
records.prohibited_inference: Communication does not create legal authority, and correction does not permit narrative manufacture.

records.title: Interim Measure Review Record
records.applicability_trigger: A provisional, urgent, ex parte, restrictive, or protective measure is taken before full ordinary process.
records.cardinality: One per interim measure and each mandatory review.
minimum_fields: notice given or reason for delay
opportunity to contest and access evidence
continuation, modification, termination, or remedy decision
links to declaration, activation, and evidence records
records.default_access: Public decision with protected evidence annex where justified
records.closure_condition: Closed by timely review and implementation of continuation, termination, or restoration.
records.prohibited_inference: An interim measure cannot renew itself, evade the 72-hour limit, or become permanent through repetition.

records.title: Cross-Border Assistance Record
records.applicability_trigger: Assistance, personnel, assets, funds, data, samples, or services cross jurisdictional boundaries.
records.cardinality: One per sending/receiving authority pair and mission; multilateral packages may link several records.
minimum_fields: request, offer, acceptance, rejection, or concurrent status
sending, receiving, host, and territorial authorities
mission, assets, personnel, duration, and limits
customs, licensing, credentials, liability, claims, and costs
data, sample, intelligence, and protected-knowledge boundaries
records.default_access: Public mission summary with protected operational annex
records.closure_condition: Closed after handback, financial reconciliation, data disposition, claims transfer, and authority restoration.
records.prohibited_inference: Cross-border assistance does not create extraterritorial jurisdiction, blanket immunity, or authority to use force.

records.title: Investigation and Evidence Handoff Record
records.applicability_trigger: Potential wrongdoing, liability, causation, regulatory breach, or rights violation requires evidence transfer to a competent investigative or prosecutorial function.
records.cardinality: One per sender, recipient, evidentiary package, and handoff event.
minimum_fields: items, data, samples, statements, and metadata transferred
chain of custody, integrity, provenance, and access history
protected sources, privileges, privacy, and non-transfer conditions
acceptance, rejection, deficiency, and correction timestamps
statement that no adjudication or enforcement result is implied
records.default_access: Restricted evidentiary record with public process summary where lawful
records.closure_condition: Closed by acknowledged custody transfer, rejection/return, or lawful disposition.
records.prohibited_inference: Evidence handoff does not establish liability, guilt, causation, remedy, or enforcement authority.

records.title: Adjudication and Enforcement Handoff Record
records.applicability_trigger: A competent authority seeks adjudication, recognition, remedy, injunction, sanction, or execution by a separately authorized body.
records.cardinality: One per referral, case, order, recognition request, or enforcement assignment.
minimum_fields: legal basis, jurisdiction, standing, and requested relief
rights, appeal, stay, and review routes
enforcement actor and separately valid mandate
scope, limits, expiry, completion, and return report
statement preserving judicial and operational separation
records.default_access: Public procedural record with protected case annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by final disposition, execution report, stay, withdrawal, or transfer to ordinary process.
records.prohibited_inference: Referral does not predetermine adjudication; an order does not authorize an unassigned body to execute itself.

records.title: Renewal State Estimate
records.applicability_trigger: A provisional or time-limited emergency action is proposed for continuation, especially beyond 72 hours, 30 days, or 90 cumulative days.
records.cardinality: One per renewal decision and active power bundle.
minimum_fields: current decision question and active powers
results and harms of measures taken
rights, distributional, worker, and continuity effects
dissent and evidence that would end the measure
renewal period, conditions, and automatic expiry
records.default_access: Public decision summary with protected evidence annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by renewal decision, expiry, termination, or transition to ordinary law.
records.prohibited_inference: Past authorization, sunk cost, institutional performance, or persistent hazard does not itself justify renewal.

records.title: Emergency Termination Certificate
records.applicability_trigger: An emergency declaration, power, mission, facility control, restriction, or extraordinary coordination ends.
records.cardinality: One per terminated declaration, power bundle, mission, or authority.
minimum_fields: terminated authority, measure, mission, and scope
legal and factual basis for termination
orders to cease, withdraw, release, return, or restore
records, data, samples, assets, credentials, and funds requiring disposition
records.default_access: Public certificate with protected implementation annex
records.closure_condition: Closed only when linked restoration and disposition obligations are verified, not merely announced.
records.prohibited_inference: A termination certificate does not prove that authority, assets, data, services, or rights have actually been restored.

records.title: Authority Restoration and Asset Return Record
records.applicability_trigger: Emergency authority, facilities, assets, access, credentials, command, custody, or territorial control must return.
records.cardinality: One per authority/asset/custody bundle and receiving owner or authority.
minimum_fields: authority and assets to be returned
condition, inventory, access, credentials, keys, software, and custody
outstanding restrictions, claims, contamination, or damage
revocation of emergency access and command
records.default_access: Public completion summary with protected inventory/security annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by verified acceptance or formally recorded unresolved dispute.
records.prohibited_inference: Publication of termination or intent to return does not complete restoration.

records.title: Emergency Data Disposition Record
records.applicability_trigger: Emergency powers expire or emergency-purpose data, samples, models, logs, or access rights reach their disposition point.
records.cardinality: At least one per ECRC-19 processing environment and termination package.
minimum_fields: data, samples, models, logs, credentials, and copies covered
delete, return, repatriate, anonymize, archive, retain, or migrate decision
ordinary-law basis for any continuing retention
breach, unresolved copy, or litigation-hold status
records.default_access: Layered access; public disposition summary where safe
records.closure_condition: Closed by verified disposition or valid continuing ordinary-law authority with review date.
records.prohibited_inference: Emergency usefulness, research value, or technical convenience does not justify indefinite retention or secondary use.

records.title: Wrongful Action and Compensation Record
records.applicability_trigger: Action may have been unlawful, excessive, mistaken, discriminatory, harmful, or based on a good-faith false alarm that caused compensable loss.
records.cardinality: One per claim, class, affected community, or remedial programme.
minimum_fields: claimant or affected class and standing
harm, loss, injury, rights effect, or property impact
remedies, compensation, rehabilitation, correction, apology, or institutional change
non-retaliation and preservation of future support
records.default_access: Public programme/ruling summary with protected claimant data
records.closure_condition: Closed after remedy completion or transfer of unresolved claims to competent process.
records.prohibited_inference: Good-faith intent does not erase harm; compensation does not retroactively validate unlawful action.

records.title: After-Action and Ordinary-Capacity Review
records.applicability_trigger: A significant alert, activation, compound event, failed escalation, or emergency response concludes or reaches a major review point.
records.cardinality: At least one per major event or mission; independent reviews may coexist.
minimum_fields: what was known, unknown, and contested
rights, community, Indigenous, worker, data, finance, and continuity effects
counterfactuals, false positives, false negatives, and intervention harm
successes, failures, near misses, and dissent
changes proposed to ordinary capacity, law, interfaces, or institutions
statement that learning does not transfer authority
records.default_access: Public report with protected annexes
records.closure_condition: Closed when recommendations are accepted, rejected with reasons, or transferred to tracked ordinary governance.
records.prohibited_inference: Operational success, competence, trust, or learning does not transfer permanent jurisdiction.

records.title: Institutional Sunset or Continuation Record
records.applicability_trigger: A temporary emergency body, programme, facility, mandate, dataset, fund, or coordination arrangement reaches review or sunset.
records.cardinality: One per temporary institution or programme.
minimum_fields: institution, mandate, authority, and original sunset
continuation, transfer, narrowing, dissolution, or no-successor options
assets, personnel, data, obligations, and claims disposition
decision authority, reasons, dissent, and next review
records.default_access: Public decision with protected operational annex
records.closure_condition: Closed by verified continuation under valid authority, transfer, or dissolution.
records.prohibited_inference: Existence, performance, accumulated expertise, or unresolved risk does not entitle an institution to continue.

records.title: Unresolved Risk and Dissent Register
records.applicability_trigger: Material uncertainty, jurisdiction gap, unresolved dissent, residual hazard, uncompleted restoration, or non-scaling decision remains open.
records.cardinality: 0..n per event; one cluster-level index may reference protected entries.
minimum_fields: risk, uncertainty, dissent, or unresolved obligation
affected systems, rights holders, and authorities
current custodian and responsible follow-up actor
records.default_access: Public index with protected entries where necessary
records.closure_condition: Closed only when the specified closure condition is met and verified.
records.prohibited_inference: An unresolved-risk register does not keep emergency powers alive or authorize precautionary coercion.
